facts.fact: The 2024 finance law (Loi n° 2023-1000 of 18 December 2023) appropriates FCFA 36,470,000,000 to programme 23209 'Comptes Spéciaux du Trésor' of the Ministry of Digital Transition and Digitalisation, bundling the ANSUT rural-technology levy account (FCFA 32.3bn voted) and the ARTCI telecoms-regulation levy account (FCFA 4.17bn voted).
facts.system: Programme 23209 Comptes Spéciaux du Trésor (ANSUT rural-technology levy account), FY2024 budget

facts.fact: In 2024 an earmarked levy on telecom operators funded the ANSUT rural-technology special account (FCFA 32.3bn voted); collection fell short, so the appropriation was cut by FCFA 8,793,791,458 to FCFA 27,676,208,542, the law or decree creating the levy is not cited.
facts.system: ANSUT rural-technology levy (compte d'affectation spéciale), programme 23209

facts.fact: The 2024 settlement law records FCFA 27,676,208,542 spent in 2024 on programme 23209 (100% of the revised figure, 75.89% of FCFA 36.47bn voted), covering the ANSUT and ARTCI levy accounts together; collections are not stated, only that they fell short by about the FCFA 8.79bn write-down.
facts.system: Programme 23209 Comptes Spéciaux du Trésor (ANSUT and ARTCI levy accounts), FY2024 outturn
